GALLERY COMPLETE!

Support Images from Page 16 onwards, Page 1-15 are the women's pinups.

The support system began officially from Fire Emblem 6 (2001), but the "Forsti's Cut" remake of Fire Emblem 5 (1999) introduces A LOT of new content, and among such content, A LOT of newly on-map and on-encampment conversations akin to Supports, also involving added returning characters (like Daisy the peppery thief girl).

This gallery will depict all of the new conversations (as available as the most recent version of the remake) but reimagining the context of the scenarios to better fit what it is said or for comedic effect.

Because of the nature of how such supports are implemented in this fan remake, they won't be sorted by characters, but by in-game first availbility (with very few exceptions).

As usual, included pinups for the girls and women as well before the support images begins proper.
